# Data model

FinPilot stores 20 tables. Each household's financial records live in one versioned JSON snapshot in `households.snapshot`; transactions are also written to the `transactions` table for indexed history. Alembic migrations in `alembic/versions/` own the hosted schema. See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for the consistency and tenant rules.

## Tables

- `action_attachments` (finpilot.persistence.action_models.ActionAttachmentRow)
- `action_proposals` (finpilot.persistence.action_models.ActionProposalRow)
- `action_receipts` (finpilot.persistence.action_models.ActionReceiptRow)
- `assistant_answers` (finpilot.persistence.database.ChatRow)
- `audit_events` (finpilot.persistence.database.AuditRow)
- `bank_connections` (finpilot.persistence.database.BankConnectionRow)
- `conversation_generations` (finpilot.persistence.conversation_models.GenerationRow)
- `conversations` (finpilot.persistence.conversation_models.ConversationRow)
- `document_chunks` (finpilot.persistence.document_models.DocumentChunkRow)
- `document_terms` (finpilot.persistence.document_models.DocumentTermRow)
- `documents` (finpilot.persistence.document_models.DocumentRow)
- `households` (finpilot.persistence.database.HouseholdRow)
- `mcp_connections` (finpilot.persistence.mcp_models.MCPConnectionRow)
- `mcp_tokens` (finpilot.persistence.mcp_models.MCPTokenRow)
- `memberships` (finpilot.persistence.database.MembershipRow)
- `rate_limits` (finpilot.persistence.database.RateLimitRow)
- `sessions` (finpilot.persistence.database.SessionRow)
- `transactions` (finpilot.persistence.database.TransactionRow)
- `users` (finpilot.persistence.database.UserRow)
- `workflow_states` (finpilot.persistence.action_models.WorkflowStateRow)
